title: Quentin and the Regiment
author: Hazel Fairweather
blurb: Casper Voss, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
